predict.question: Playing a repeated game with a partner, 90% of your rounds go smoothly and earn you +4 points. In the other 10%, a mistake leaves you at −1. What do you average per round?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Cooperation depends on how strategies handle errors as well as successful exchanges.
modelBoundary: Without repair the mean is {A}; reducing the error loss raises it to {B}. The cooperation probability does not change.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This is one stipulated encounter. It does not simulate repeated strategies, retaliation or the book’s tournament.
